citation: Jiu's Sharing Station, "China Payment, Parcel & Security Rules", checked 2026-11-10, https://jiunotes.top/en/life/
note: Every entry carries the official source that states it and the date it was last checked. Rules and figures change without announcement; compare checked_on against your travel date.

facts.claim_en: Static QR-code payment: a single customer's bank accounts and payment accounts combined are capped at 500 CNY per day

source.name: 中国人民银行《条码支付业务规范（试行）》

facts.claim_en: QR-code payment verified with fewer than two authentication factors: capped at 1000 CNY per day

source.name: 中国人民银行《条码支付业务规范（试行）》

facts.claim_en: QR-code payment verified with two or more factors (no digital certificate or e-signature): capped at 5000 CNY per day

source.name: 中国人民银行《条码支付业务规范（试行）》

facts.claim_en: RMB cash is the most basic means of payment in China; no unit or individual may refuse it

source.name: 中国人民银行公告〔2020〕第18号

facts.claim_en: WeChat Pay with a foreign card: 6500 CNY per transaction, 50000 CNY per month, 65000 CNY per year

source.name: 腾讯官方客服·微信支付外卡绑定和使用指南

facts.claim_en: WeChat Pay foreign-card transaction fee: free up to 200 CNY per transaction, 3% above 200 CNY

source.name: 腾讯官方客服·微信支付外卡绑定和使用指南

facts.claim_en: Alipay with a foreign card: 3000 CNY per transaction, 50000 CNY per month, 60000 CNY per year

source.name: 中国民航网·境外旅客支付问答（据支付宝官方外卡指引）

facts.claim_en: Foreign-card cash withdrawal at an ATM in China: no more than 3000 CNY per transaction

source.name: 中国民航网·境外旅客支付问答（据支付宝官方外卡指引）

facts.claim_en: China's prohibited-items list for postal and express shipments has 19 categories

source.name: 国家邮政局《禁止寄递物品指导目录》

facts.claim_en: Real-name registration for parcels: senders must show a valid ID; a foreign citizen's passport is accepted

source.name: 《邮件快件实名收寄管理办法》

facts.claim_en: Express companies must deliver to the agreed address, recipient or designated recipient, and tell them to inspect in person

source.name: 《快递暂行条例》（2019 修订）

facts.claim_en: Without the user's consent, a courier may not confirm receipt on their behalf or drop the parcel into a smart locker or station box (fines up to 30000 CNY)

source.name: 交通运输部《快递市场管理办法》2023年第22号

facts.claim_en: Senders must truthfully state the name, nature and quantity of the item on the waybill

source.name: 《快递暂行条例》（2019 修订）

facts.claim_en: Power banks and lithium batteries are banned from checked luggage; up to 100 Wh may be carried on board, 100-160 Wh needs airline approval (max 2 pieces), above 160 Wh is banned

source.name: 中国民用航空局·航空旅行常识

facts.claim_en: Cigarette lighters, matches and other ignition sources are banned from both carry-on and checked luggage on flights

source.name: 中国民用航空局·航空旅行常识

facts.claim_en: Alcoholic drinks with an alcohol content above 70% by volume are banned from air transport

source.name: 中国民用航空局·航空旅行常识

facts.claim_en: From 28 June 2025, power banks without a clear CCC mark, or with an unclear or recalled mark, are banned on domestic flights

source.name: 中国民航网（民航局通知，首都机场落实）

facts.claim_en: China SIM/phone real-name registration: network entry requires a valid ID; a foreign citizen's passport is accepted

source.name: 《电话用户真实身份信息登记规定》（工信部令第25号）

facts.claim_en: For online, phone and mail-order purchases, the consumer may return within 7 days of receiving the item without giving a reason

source.name: 《中华人民共和国消费者权益保护法》第二十五条

facts.claim_en: Online shopping users in China reached 974 million by December 2024, 87.9% of all internet users

source.name: 中国互联网络信息中心（CNNIC）第55次报告

facts.claim_en: Online travel booking users in China reached 548 million by December 2024, 49.5% of internet users

source.name: 中国互联网络信息中心（CNNIC）第55次报告

facts.claim_en: Food-delivery drone routes in China exceeded 53 by the end of 2024 (more than 50)

source.name: 中国互联网络信息中心（CNNIC）第55次报告

facts.claim_en: China's internet users reached 1.108 billion by December 2024, a 78.6% penetration rate

source.name: 中国互联网络信息中心（CNNIC）第55次报告

facts.claim_en: 5G base stations built in China: 4.191 million by November 2024

source.name: 中国互联网络信息中心（CNNIC）第55次报告

facts.claim_en: Courier enterprises must file their delivery end-point outlets with the local postal administration within 20 days of opening; the outlets need no business licence.

source.name: 中国政府网（快递暂行条例，国务院公报2019年增刊1）

facts.claim_en: Undeliverable and unreturnable letters are destroyed under postal supervision if unclaimed for more than 6 months from the date confirmed unreturnable; other items are registered and handled per regulation.

source.name: 中国政府网（快递暂行条例，国务院公报2019年增刊1）

facts.claim_en: Courier enterprises must handle a user's service-quality complaint and notify the user within 7 days of receiving it.

source.name: 中国政府网（快递暂行条例，国务院公报2019年增刊1）

facts.claim_en: A courier enterprise ceasing operations must announce it publicly 10 days in advance, notify the postal administration in writing, return its licence and properly handle undelivered items.

source.name: 中国政府网（快递暂行条例，国务院公报2019年增刊1）

facts.claim_en: Operating a delivery end-point outlet without filing, or stopping without the advance notice, brings a correction order and a fine of up to 10,000 CNY; in serious cases a fine of 10,000-50,000 CNY.

source.name: 中国政府网（快递暂行条例，国务院公报2019年增刊1）

facts.claim_en: Using a shared brand, trade name or waybill without unified service, safety and process management brings a fine of 10,000-50,000 CNY; in serious cases a fine of 50,000-100,000 CNY.

source.name: 中国政府网（快递暂行条例，国务院公报2019年增刊1）

facts.claim_en: Failing to build a waybill and e-data management system, failing to destroy waybills on schedule, or selling or leaking user information brings confiscation of illegal gains and a fine of 10,000-50,000 CNY; in serious cases a fine of 50,000-100,000 CNY.

source.name: 中国政府网（快递暂行条例，国务院公报2019年增刊1）

facts.claim_en: The Interim Regulation on Express Delivery took effect on 1 May 2018.

source.name: 中国政府网（快递暂行条例，国务院公报2019年增刊1）

facts.claim_en: China's emergency numbers are 110 (police), 119 (fire), 120 (ambulance) and 122 (traffic accidents).
facts.claim_zh: 中国常用应急号码：报警求助 110、火警 119、医疗救护 120、交通事故 122。

source.name: The State Council of China (中国政府网)

facts.claim_en: China uses a single time zone nationwide — China Standard Time (UTC+8), also known as Beijing Time.
facts.claim_zh: 中国全国统一使用东八区时间（UTC+8），即北京时间。

source.name: China Services Info (中国日报/中国网)

facts.claim_en: China's mains electricity is 220V at 50Hz.
facts.claim_zh: 中国民用电为 220 伏、50 赫兹。

source.name: China.org.cn (中国网)

facts.claim_en: Air passengers flying domestic routes in China pay a CNY 50 civil aviation development fund per trip; international and regional (Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan) departures pay CNY 90, which includes a CNY 20 tourism development fund.
facts.claim_zh: 在中国境内乘机，国内航班每人次缴民航发展基金 50 元；国际及地区（港澳台）航班出境每人次 90 元（其中含旅游发展基金 20 元）。

source.name: Ministry of Finance via The State Council (中国政府网)

facts.claim_en: The civil aviation development fund is waived for children aged 12 and under, diplomatic-passport holders departing on international flights, and passengers on domestic regional (feeder) flights.
facts.claim_zh: 12 周岁及以下儿童、持外交护照乘坐国际及地区航班出境的旅客、乘坐国内支线航班的旅客，可免缴民航发展基金。

source.name: Ministry of Finance via The State Council (中国政府网)

facts.claim_en: Foreign cards bound to Alipay or WeChat Pay in China carry a per-transaction limit of USD 5,000 and an annual cumulative limit of USD 50,000 — raised from USD 1,000 and USD 10,000 in 2024 at the central bank's direction.
facts.claim_zh: 境外银行卡绑定支付宝或微信支付后，单笔交易限额 5000 美元、年累计限额 5 万美元（2024 年由单笔 1000 美元、年累计 1 万美元提高）。

source.name: People's Bank of China (中国人民银行)

facts.claim_en: Foreign visitors can pay in China two ways — 'card-in, wallet-out' (bind an overseas bank card to Alipay/WeChat Pay) or 'wallet-in' (pay merchants directly with a home e-wallet app) — and cash is still accepted at 99.3% of businesses surveyed by the central bank.
facts.claim_zh: 境外来华人员有两种移动支付方式：「外卡内绑」（境外银行卡绑支付宝/微信支付）与「外包内用」（用本国电子钱包 App 直接在境内商户付款）；同时现金兜底，央行暗访显示 99.3% 的经营主体支持现金支付。

source.name: People's Bank of China (中国人民银行)

facts.claim_en: China had 7,716 star-rated hotels at the end of 2024, with an average room rate of CNY 371.7 per night and an average occupancy of 49.2%.
facts.claim_zh: 截至 2024 年末，全国共有星级饭店 7716 家，平均房价 371.7 元/间夜，平均出租率 49.2%。

source.name: Ministry of Culture and Tourism (文化和旅游部)

facts.claim_en: A temporary motor vehicle driving permit is issued by the vehicle management office: valid 3 months for short stays, extendable to 1 year if the stay exceeds 3 months. Visitors driving a rented Chinese car apply at the office in the city where the rental company is registered; those driving their own temporarily imported vehicle apply within 2 days of entry.
facts.claim_zh: 临时机动车驾驶许可由车管所核发：短期停留有效期 3 个月，停居留超过 3 个月可延长至 1 年。驾驶租赁的中国机动车，向租车单位所在市车管所申领；驾驶自带临时入境车辆的，须于入境后 2 日内申领。

source.name: Ministry of Public Security — Provisions on Temporarily Entered Motor Vehicles and Drivers (Order No. 90)

facts.claim_en: Converting a foreign licence into a Chinese one requires passing the theory test (Subject 1) for small cars; bus, truck and trailer categories require Subjects 1, 2 and 3. Non-Chinese licences need a certified Chinese translation.
facts.claim_zh: 境外驾照换领中国驾照：小型汽车需考科目一；大型客车、重型牵引挂车、城市公交车、中型客车、大型货车需考科目一、二、三。非中文驾照须附翻译机构或公证机构的中文译本。

source.name: Provisions on the Application and Use of Motor Vehicle Driving Licences (MPS Order No. 162)

facts.claim_en: Duty-free allowance on entry to mainland China: 400 cigarettes, or 20 cigars, or 500 g of tobacco, plus 1.5 litres of alcoholic drinks above 12% ABV.
facts.claim_zh: 入境中国大陆免税限量：香烟 400 支，或雪茄 20 支，或烟丝 500 克；12 度以上酒精饮料 1.5 升。

source.name: General Administration of Customs of China

facts.claim_en: Travellers arriving from Hong Kong or Macao get half the standard allowance: 200 cigarettes, or 10 cigars, or 250 g of tobacco, and 0.75 litres of alcohol above 12% ABV.
facts.claim_zh: 自香港、澳门入境的旅客免税限量减半：香烟 200 支，或雪茄 10 支，或烟丝 250 克；12 度以上酒精饮料 0.75 升。

source.name: General Administration of Customs of China

facts.claim_en: Cash limits: each traveller may carry up to CNY 20,000 in renminbi; inbound foreign-currency cash above the equivalent of USD 5,000 must be declared in writing to customs.
facts.claim_zh: 现金限额：每人每次出入境可携带人民币 20,000 元；入境携带外币现钞超过等值 5,000 美元须向海关书面申报。

source.name: General Administration of Customs of China

facts.claim_en: Cross-border e-commerce retail imports are capped at CNY 5,000 per order and CNY 26,000 per person per year; the remaining quota can be checked on the customs website or the Zhangshang Haiguan mini program.
facts.claim_zh: 跨境电商零售进口限额：单次 5,000 元、每人每年 26,000 元；剩余额度可在海关总署官网或「掌上海关」小程序查询。

source.name: General Administration of Customs of China

facts.claim_en: Hainan island duty-free shopping: each departing traveller aged 16 or over gets a CNY 100,000 annual allowance with no limit on the number of purchases. It covers goods bought in duty-free shops or approved online channels and collected when leaving the island by air, train or ferry (not when leaving China).
facts.claim_zh: 海南离岛免税：年满 16 周岁的离岛旅客每人每年免税购物额度 10 万元人民币、不限次数；在免税店或经批准的网上窗口购买，乘飞机、火车、轮船离岛（不离境）时提货。

source.name: General Administration of Customs — Hainan duty-free supervision

facts.claim_en: From 1 November 2025 Hainan expanded its duty-free range to 47 categories and allowed domestic goods into duty-free shops with tax refunds; island residents with a departure record that calendar year can buy and take goods immediately in store, still within the CNY 100,000 annual cap.
facts.claim_zh: 2025 年 11 月 1 日起，海南离岛免税商品扩至 47 大类，并允许国产商品进店销售享退税；当年有离岛记录的岛内居民可「即购即提」不限次数，但仍受每人每年 10 万元额度限制。

source.name: Hainan Provincial Tax Service, State Taxation Administration

facts.claim_en: Hotels register foreign guests automatically. Anyone staying anywhere other than a hotel must register with the local police within 24 hours of arrival — done by the guest or by the host. Failure to register brings a warning, and in serious cases a fine of CNY 1,000-5,000.
facts.claim_zh: 外国人在旅馆住宿由旅馆自动办理登记；在旅馆以外的住所（亲友家、租住房屋、自有住所）住宿，须在入住后 24 小时内由本人或留宿人向居住地公安机关登记。未按规定办理的，给予警告；情节严重的处 1,000-5,000 元罚款。

source.name: National Immigration Administration — Announcement No. 7 of 2026 (Exit and Entry Administration Law, Art. 39)

facts.claim_en: Since 21 September 2026 foreign visitors can complete the non-hotel accommodation registration online — via the NIA service website (s.nia.gov.cn), the 12367 app, or the 12367 WeChat/Alipay mini program. Online registration has the same legal effect as registering at a police station; walk-in registration remains available.
facts.claim_zh: 自 2026 年 9 月 21 日起，外国人旅馆以外住宿登记可在网上办理：国家移民管理局政务服务网站（s.nia.gov.cn）、「移民局12367」APP、微信或支付宝小程序。网上办理与现场办理具有同等效力，线下渠道继续保留。

source.name: National Immigration Administration — Announcement No. 7 of 2026 (Exit and Entry Administration Law, Art. 39)

facts.claim_en: Since 28 June 2025 domestic flights in China ban power banks that have no CCC (3C) mark, an unclear CCC mark, or belong to a recalled model or batch. The rule applies to domestic flights only; camera and drone batteries are not affected.
facts.claim_zh: 自 2025 年 6 月 28 日起，中国境内航班禁止携带没有 3C 标识、3C 标识不清晰、属被召回型号或批次的充电宝；该规定仅针对境内航班，相机电池和无人机电池不受影响。
facts.figure: 28 Jun 2025 CCC power bank rule since

source.name: Civil Aviation Administration of China

facts.claim_en: Power bank capacity rules: they must travel in hand luggage, never checked baggage. Up to 100 Wh needs no approval; 100-160 Wh needs airline approval and at most two units; above 160 Wh is banned. Using a power bank in flight is not allowed.
facts.claim_zh: 充电宝容量规定：只能随身携带或放手提行李，严禁托运；额定能量不超过 100Wh 无需批准；100-160Wh 须经航空公司批准且最多 2 个；超过 160Wh 严禁携带；飞行途中不得使用充电宝充电。

source.name: Civil Aviation Administration of China

facts.claim_en: China requires real-name registration for all phone numbers. Foreign visitors can buy a SIM card with their passport, but only at staffed carrier-owned stores — airport outlets are the easiest option; convenience stores do not sell SIM cards. Short-term tourist SIMs (7, 15 or 30 days) are offered in places such as Shanghai and Hainan.
facts.claim_zh: 中国实行电话用户实名登记制度。外国人可凭护照办理手机卡，但须到运营商自营营业厅（机场网点最方便），便利店不售卡；上海、海南等地提供 7/15/30 天短期旅游卡，到期自动注销。

source.name: Regulations on Real-Name Registration of Telephone Users, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

facts.claim_en: Beijing was the first mainland city to let foreign cards tap straight through the subway gates. Holders of an overseas-issued Mastercard or Visa can ride Beijing's 27 urban rail lines and the S2 suburban railway line without buying a ticket or installing an app. Elsewhere you buy a single-ride card at a window or machine, or use the Alipay transit QR code.
facts.claim_zh: 北京是中国内地首个支持境外银行卡直接拍卡过地铁闸机的城市：持境外发行的 Mastercard 或 Visa，可乘坐北京 27 条城市轨道交通线路及市郊铁路 S2 线，无需购票或下载 APP。其他城市多在窗口/自助机买单程卡，或用支付宝乘车码。

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: To get a temporary Chinese driving permit, take your passport, your overseas licence with a Chinese translation, and a recent one-inch colour photo (bareheaded, front-facing, white background) to a public security traffic management service hall. Short-stay visitors get 3 months; if the stay exceeds 3 months it can be extended to no more than 1 year. A permit can be used for multiple entries within its validity without reapplying.
facts.claim_zh: 申领中国临时驾驶许可：携带护照、境外驾驶证及其中文翻译文本、近期一寸彩色白底免冠正面照片，到公安交管服务大厅办理。入境短期停留者有效期 3 个月；停居留超过 3 个月可延长至不超过 1 年。有效期内可多次入境使用，无需重新申请。

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: Hotels register foreign guests at the front desk against a passport or Foreign Permanent Resident ID. At check-out you can pay cash in RMB, by bank card, by Alipay or by WeChat Pay — but ask first whether the property takes Mastercard or Visa, because acceptance of international cards varies. Some hotels also accept Apple Pay and PayPal.
facts.claim_zh: 酒店前台凭护照或外国人永久居留身份证为外籍客人办理登记。到店支付可选人民币现金、银行卡、支付宝、微信；但**须先问是否收 Mastercard / Visa**——各酒店受理国际卡情况不一。部分酒店支持 Apple Pay、PayPal。
facts.value: passport registration + ask about intl cards
facts.figure: passport registration + ask about intl cards hotel check-in

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: Foreigners working in China need a work permit: short-term workers staying up to 30 days work on the permit’s stated period under a Z visa, while those staying over 30 days get a work-type residence permit valid 90 days.
facts.claim_zh: 外国人在中国境内工作应取得外国人工作许可；工作期限不超过30日的短期工作人员按许可注明的期限并在Z字签证停留期停留，超过30日的可办理停留期90日的工作类居留证件。

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: A Chinese work permit should be renewed by the employer at least 30 days before expiry; if personal details (name, passport number, position) change, an amendment must be filed within 10 working days.
facts.claim_zh: 工作许可有效期届满30日前由用人单位申请延期；个人信息（姓名、护照号、职务）变更的，应自变更之日起10个工作日内提出变更申请。

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: If you lose your passport in China, report the loss immediately to the police station where it was lost; for immigration or entry-exit questions call the 12367 service hotline.
facts.claim_zh: 护照遗失时请立即向遗失地派出所报失；咨询移民或出入境事务请拨打12367服务热线。

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: Bank branches in China provide RMB small-change exchange, so you can swap for loose change at the counter or self-service machine, or buy a pre-packed "change wallet" of mixed denominations at the counter.
facts.claim_zh: 商业银行网点提供人民币现金零钞兑换服务，可在柜台、自助设备直接兑换零钞，或在柜台等值兑换已封装好的含不同面额的零钱包产品。
facts.figure: RMB small change bank branch counter / self-service machine

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: After arrival, foreign currency can be exchanged at airports, land ports and seaports of entry, at bank branches and exchange counters marked with a foreign-exchange sign, and via ATMs using international cards to withdraw RMB.
facts.claim_zh: 入境后可在国际机场、陆路口岸、港口等入境口岸所在地，以及标有个人本外币兑换标识的商业银行网点柜台、外币兑换机构、自助兑换机兑换，也可通过ATM机使用国际银行卡提取人民币现钞。
facts.figure: airports / ports / bank branches / ATMs exchange channels

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: China’s metro system serves 55 cities; foreigners can buy a single-trip ticket at the station window or ticket machine, or get a stored-value transit card with a passport, paying by domestic or overseas card, RMB cash or mobile pay.
facts.claim_zh: 中国共有55个城市开通地铁；外国乘客可在地铁站售票窗口或自助售票机购买单次票，持护照可办一卡通；购卡可使用境内外银行卡、人民币现金、移动支付APP。

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: On city buses, foreigners can pay with RMB cash (have change ready), buy a bus card at a bus company outlet with a passport, or use Alipay; some transport apps also support a QR boarding code.
facts.claim_zh: 乘坐公交可选择支付人民币现金（建议备好零钱）、持护照到公交公司营业网点办公交卡、使用支付宝；部分APP支持乘车码扫码上车。
facts.figure: cash / bus card / Alipay bus payment methods

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: To rent a car in China, a foreign customer needs a passport or Foreign Permanent Residence ID, a valid Chinese driving licence and an international or domestic credit card; first-time renters should allow at least 1 working day for ID verification.
facts.claim_zh: 外国客户租车需携带护照或外国人永久居留身份证、中国有效驾驶证、国际/国内信用卡；第一次租车需至少提前1个工作日核验身份证件信息。

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: A temporary Chinese driving permit is valid 3 months for a short stay, extendable up to 1 year if the stay exceeds 3 months, and can be used on multiple entries within its validity without re-applying.
facts.claim_zh: 入境短期停留可申领有效期3个月的临时驾驶许可；停居留超过3个月的，有效期可延长至不超过1年；有效期内可多次入境使用，无需重新申请。
facts.figure: up to 1 year if stay > 3 months; multiple entries

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: Foreign guests can book hotels via Trip.com international (site, app or Alipay mini-program TripHotels) paying by international card, and pay on arrival by RMB cash, bank card, Alipay or WeChat — some hotels also accept Apple Pay and PayPal, so check in advance.
facts.claim_zh: 外国旅客可通过携程国际版Trip.com在线预订并支持国际银行卡支付；到店支付可选人民币现金、银行卡、支付宝、微信，部分酒店支持Apple Pay和PayPal，支付前请提前咨询。
facts.figure: Trip.com + cash / card / Alipay / WeChat hotel booking & payment

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: A foreigner is a Chinese tax resident if they have a domicile in China, or no domicile but stay 183 days or more cumulatively in a tax year; residents are taxed on worldwide income, non-residents only on China-source income.
facts.claim_zh: 外国人士在中国境内有住所，或无住所而一个纳税年度内累计居住满183天的，为中国税收居民；居民从境内和境外取得所得均缴纳个税，非居民仅就境内所得缴纳。

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: Chinese tax residents with the four comprehensive incomes (wages, remuneration, author’s remuneration, royalties) must file an annual reconciliation from 1 March to 30 June of the following year; non-residents do not file a comprehensive reconciliation.
facts.claim_zh: 中国税收居民的工资薪金、劳务报酬、稿酬、特许权使用费等四项综合所得，应在取得所得的次年3月1日至6月30日内办理汇算清缴；非居民个人不办理综合所得汇算清缴。

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: China’s network of double-taxation avoidance agreements covers 114 countries (regions); eligible foreigners may claim treaty benefits (reduced or exempt tax) on their own declaration, keeping supporting documents for inspection.
facts.claim_zh: 中国的避免双重征税协定网络已覆盖114个国家（地区）；符合条件的外国人士可自行享受协定减税或免税待遇，有关资料留存备查。

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)

facts.claim_en: Foreigners working in China must join social insurance; the employer must register the employee within 30 days of obtaining the work documents, and contribution base and ratios match those of Chinese employees in the same locality.
facts.claim_zh: 外国人在华工作应参加社会保险；用人单位应自办理工作证件之日起30日内为其办理社会保险登记，缴费基数、缴费比例与参保地中国籍参保人员一致。

source.name: Ministry of Commerce — Guide to Working and Living in China for Foreign Business People (2025 Edition) (商务部《外国商务人士在华工作生活指引（2025年版）》)
